This occupation represents wholesalers or manufacturers selling goods that require technical or scientific knowledge, explains product specifications and uses, demonstrates products, provides ongoing technical support, prepares quotes, orders and sales contracts, works with engineers and arranges installation and testing; sales representatives are not automatically regarded as sales engineers or product design owners.
